name: Travis Nelson
occupation: State Representative; registered nurse and union representative

bio.statement: In his official biography Nelson says he joined the legislature as the first Black LGBTQIA+ member of the body.
bio.excerpt: I am proud to join the legislature as the first ever Black LGBTQIA+ member of this body

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Nelson member page

bio.statement: The Oregon Capital Chronicle reported at his appointment that Nelson is a registered nurse working as a union representative with the Oregon Nurses Association.
bio.excerpt: Nelson is a registered nurse who now works full time as a union representative with the Oregon Nurses Association.
